carousel.subject: Indian Geography

questions.q: Duniya ki sabse unchi parvat chotti kaunsi hai?
questions.why: Mount Everest (8,849 m) duniya ki sabse unchi chotti hai, Nepal-China border par.

questions.q: Khyber Pass kin do deshon ke beech sthit hai?
questions.why: Khyber Pass Hindukush range mein Pakistan-Afghanistan border par hai.

questions.q: Nathu La Pass kis rajya mein sthit hai?
questions.why: Nathu La Pass Sikkim mein hai, yeh India-China trade route hai.

questions.q: Shivalik range ko kis naam se bhi jaana jata hai?
questions.why: Shivalik sabse bahar ki range hai, isliye 'Bahari Himalaya' kehte hain.

questions.q: Bharat ki sabse purani parvat shrinkhala kaunsi hai?
questions.why: Aravalli range duniya ki sabse purani parvat shrinkhalaon mein se ek hai.
